text:
Alex M: Heads-up — Nova Systems just asked for an exec escalation. They want to kick off a POC next week but we have three blockers: security questionnaire answers, committed capacity pricing for a 6mo Dedicated pool, and an SSO/KMS integration plan. Can we triage? :exclamation:
Priya R: Thanks Alex. What are their expected QPS and avg token size during the POC? Need those to size Dedicated and draft pricing.
Alex M: Rough numbers from the AE call: ~200 QPS peak, mostly short prompts (~50 tokens), but bursts to 1k QPS for short windows during demos. Estimated 10k–15k tokens/day typical; demo days spike.
Jordan L: We should also prepare a 15m exec briefing for their CTO/VP Eng. Want to include fallback plan if Dedicated isn't ready day 1. I can own the slides if someone feeds me numbers. :+1:
Devon C: FYI infra: our EU-west dedicated pool is 85% committed next week. Can still do a temporary burst but needs approval.
Devon C: Option A: allocate a temporary burst pool (30 GPU-minutes) and route demo traffic there. Option B: use Hosted API fallback with price uplift.
Devon C: I opened an internal quota request — run this to create the allocation ticket if you want to self-serve:
```
rbw infra request-burst --team sales --pool eu-west-1 --qps 500 --duration 4h
```
Elena S: For security questionnaire: we'll need
- Network diagram + dataflow
- KMS/HSM details (do they require BYO KMS?)
- SOC2 attestation and encryption at rest details
Timeline?
Alex M: Customer wants answers by EOD Friday to proceed with legal. They mentioned BYO KMS is preferred but not mandatory for POC. I'll upload their questionnaire link: https://nova-sec/qs/abcd
Priya R: Pricing note — they asked for committed 6mo pricing with an option to convert to Private later. Can finance provide a starter quote (Reserved Dedicated, monthly commit) + short-term hosted fallback rate?
Jordan L: Also request a C-level talking point: "we can guarantee a demo-ready environment for your exec day with a fallback to hosted API at known rates". Keeps exec comfortable.
Devon C: infra-bot: created ticket INC-4821 for burst allocation and flagged for oncall approval.
infra-bot: INC-4821 created by rbw-cli; approver: @Devon C; status: awaiting-approval.
Elena S: I'll draft answers to the questionnaire earliest tomorrow AM. Also will need a copy of their MSA or DPAs if they want KMS details.
Alex M: Action items from me: 1) send questionnaire to legal (sent) 2) schedule exec call Tues 09:00 PT (tentative) 3) confirm BYO KMS requirement with customer (in progress).
Priya R: I'll coordinate pricing ask with finance and post a ballpark by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan L: I'll start slides and add fallback wording. Share any infra numbers asap.
Devon C: If we want the burst approved today ping me and I'll escalate to oncall. Otherwise ticket will wait until morning.
Alex M: Thanks team — main blocker is security answers by Friday and infra approval for demo bursts. I’ll keep Nova in the loop and post any changes here. :pray:
